Arrg is a giant troll, named after the sound made by the first thing he ate. Arrg won't hesitate to smash his victims' bones to dust with his hammer so anyone approaching should be quick on their feet.

Quest: Troll Romance

Combat: Oh no, it's the beastly Arrg! He'll attack you with a mixture of melee and ranged as he hurls rocks into your face! Bam!
